responseMessageContents.text: The 503 error is likely a transient build error, but let me check the key files for any issues that might cause problems. Let me check for TypeScript errors.

projectStructureErrors: Project must have only one index file. If part of the path is optional, like /(marketing)/index.tsx, it counts as index.tsx. Found 2 index files: app/(tabs)/(mountains)/index.tsx, app/(tabs)/index.tsx

responseMessageContents.text:
The issue is a routing conflict — there are two index files resolving to `/`. The `app/(tabs)/index.tsx` and `app/(tabs)/(mountains)/index.tsx` both map to the root route.

Since `app/(tabs)/index.tsx` is just a redirect/placeholder and `(mountains)` is already registered with `href: null` on the index tab, I'll fix this by removing the conflicting index file.
Now I need to update the tab layout to remove the `index` tab screen reference since the file no longer exists.

The build error is fixed. The issue was a routing conflict — both `app/(tabs)/index.tsx` and `app/(tabs)/(mountains)/index.tsx` resolved to the same `/` route. I removed the redundant `app/(tabs)/index.tsx` redirect file and cleaned up the tab layout reference to it. The project now builds cleanly with no errors.
